strings.Backend local do método: contratos tipad: Local backend for the method: typed contracts, state machine, persistence, encrypted vault, and provenance. 31 routes, 33 HTTP operations, and 188 automated tests passed.
strings.Pórtico, entrada governada, unidade e re: Portico, governed entry, unity, and conducting.
strings.A forma reúne acessos sob uma estrutura: The form gathers entrances under a common structure and makes the conducting principle visible.
strings.O Rei representa especialização sob regê: The King stands for specialization under common conducting, never a hierarchy of importance: unity through grammar; distinction through movement.
strings.Robô de entrada com pseudonimização por: Intake robot with vault-based pseudonymization, screening for sealed cases, and a run log.
CSV inventory as the source of truth. SHA-256 hash as key, deduplication by file and by CNJ case number.
strings.OCR para PDF digitalizado sem camada de: OCR for scanned PDFs without a text layer, reusing the existing engines and vault.
strings.Painel operacional em linguagem ATRIO, s: Read-only operational dashboard in the ATRIO visual language.
strings.Inventários separados, documental e de p: Separate inventories, one documentary and one of pseudonyms, with a consolidated XLSX.
strings.Monorepo reorganizado e CORPUS fechado c: Monorepo reorganized and CORPUS closed as a versioned package. Validated against a live PostgreSQL on 27 Jul 2026.
strings.A forma organiza camadas e sustenta uma: The form organizes layers and supports a stable, legible, and preservable base.
strings.A Torre traduz a função de classificar,: The Rook expresses the task of classifying, keeping, and retrieving the documentary memory that grounds the system.
strings.Release inicial. Prompt operacional com: Initial release. Operational prompt with golden rules, logical sanction, and a nine-year caseload.
strings.Banco de modelos cede lugar a biblioteca: The template bank gives way to a library of legal grounds, with material fit and temporal priority.
strings.Pacote de dez arquivos nomeados substitu: A package of ten named files replaces the hosted collections.
strings.Recurso inominado e embargos unificados: Small-claims appeals and motions for clarification unified under automatic identification of the document type.
strings.Fontes autorizadas reduzidas a três arqu: Authorized sources reduced to three files. Consulting an unlisted source is now prohibited.
strings.Modularização por fase. Estado do Caso c: Modularization by phase. Case Status as an explicit object and a formal separation between RATIO and LUX.
strings.Camada Instructions com precedência sobr: Instructions layer taking precedence over the core. One file per module, writs of mandamus with their own procedure, and cascading invalidation.
strings.Patch de governança. A classificação de: Governance patch. Risk classification adjusts only the density of the exposition; it does not allow phases, gates, mandatory outputs, or validations to be condensed. The workflow remains unchanged.
strings.Governança de incidência e isolamento mo: Applicability governance and modular isolation. A firewall excludes inactive modules from the precedence chain; the Critical Layer becomes platform-agnostic, with no presumption that sources are available and portable distribution as a plugin.
strings.Percurso, direção, inflexão e desvio con: Path, direction, inflection, and controlled deviation.
strings.O movimento não avança em linha automáti: The movement does not advance in an automatic line: it changes direction according to verifiable choices.
strings.O Cavalo traduz a formulação em fases, c: The Knight expresses drafting in phases, with controlled inflections and human validation along the path.
strings.Primeiro protótipo executável, com triag: First executable prototype, with triage and two fixed axes.
strings.Segunda versão autônoma da API, com onze: Second standalone version of the API, with eleven axes and outputs for an interface and a technical report.
strings.Integração ao ATRIO, com auditoria a par: Integration into ATRIO, with auditing from RATIO’s delivery and defined control points.
strings.Separação entre núcleo e módulos de domí: Separation between core and domain modules, a versioned audit package, and human adjudication set out in the contract.
strings.Manual canônico da auditoria por onze ei: Canonical manual for the eleven-axis audit, with a formalized flow, technical and plain outputs, and trace and grounding controls.
strings.Consolidação canônica. Formação, admissã: Canonical consolidation. Formation, admission, and reassessment of doubts in distinct stages, with end-to-end traceability; 156 checks passed.
strings.Formalização dos controles e resolução d: Formalization of the controls and resolution of implementation blockers, without changing the lenses.
strings.Fechamento computacional. Correção de re: Computational closure. Correction of conditional rules and formal verification of the package’s dependencies.
strings.Reestruturação adversarial. Cada dúvida: Adversarial restructuring. Each doubt is now argued for and against independently before the decision; reports in two layers, technical and plain.
strings.Manual oficial 1.1.0. Auditoria por onze: Official manual 1.1.0. Audit through eleven lenses, with independent confrontation of each doubt and questions linked to the passages of the ruling.
strings.Escrutínio, confronto, tensão produtiva: Scrutiny, confrontation, productive tension, and return to the legal ground.
strings.A forma concentra força no núcleo e ampl: The form concentrates strength at the core and widens the field of confrontation without losing its point of origin.
strings.A Rainha traduz a amplitude do escrutíni: The Queen expresses the breadth of scrutiny and the return to the legal ground when a formulation needs to be put under tension.
strings.Refinador final com entrega em três bloc: Final refiner delivering in three blocks, with no phases and no handshake.
strings.Protocolo de sete fases com aprovação ob: Seven-phase protocol with mandatory approval, a markup system, and a hierarchy of rules.
strings.Gatilhos de modo cedem lugar a #GUIA. Se: Mode triggers give way to #GUIA. Six phases, with style promoted to a phase of its own.
strings.Obrigatoriedade do fluxo revogada. Entre: Mandatory flow revoked. Full delivery by default and optional intermediate questions.
strings.Modularização em onze arquivos, com vali: Modularization into eleven files, with silent validation and its own installation. The system stops being a prompt.
strings.Camada de anonimização com três modos de: Anonymization layer with three destination modes and forty identifier types. Eleven files reduced to three.
strings.Diagonalidade, projeção, depuração, legi: Diagonality, projection, refinement, legibility, and finish.
strings.A diagonal projeta e depura, conduzindo: The diagonal projects and refines, guiding the eye without breaking the grounding of the earlier form.
strings.O Bispo traduz o refinamento que melhora: The Bishop expresses the refinement that improves legibility and finish without crossing the boundary of the merits.
